title: 第1411章 霉菌说来就来第1410章 炼器盟石油
slug: 厨神把师姐们喂成女帝
content_zh:
“霉菌？”
会客厅里的几人都一愣。
黑油那种东西动不动就着火，还能滋生霉菌？
而且自打踏上修炼之路以来，发霉长毛这种情况基本就看不见了。
除非遇到那种蘑菇修炼出来的修士，那是真能在人身上直接种蘑菇的。
“多谢林道友提醒，我会小心注意的。”
贾德虽说不知道林东方说这话是啥意思，但还是笑着点点头。
不管别人态度如何，贾德始终保持一张笑脸。
颇有些唾面自干的意思。
“如此我们就先告辞了。”
林东方从始至终也没提轻铁矿这茬。
楚成和黑甲圣子也没多问，随着林东方登上宝剑号，缓缓驶离了炼器盟大星。
地面上，贾德死死盯着宝剑号，眼睛里的贪念是不加掩饰的。
“如此完美的科技瑰宝…若是能拆解获得核心技术…”
贾德眯着眼睛思索片刻后，联系了丹盟盟主厉久。
不多时，厉久便来到了贾德的密室。
“滋生霉菌？”
厉久听到这四个字后也是一愣，同样摸不到头脑。
想了很久，他才灵光一闪，说道，“林东方此人行事百无禁忌，莫非他是在威胁你？要是你不同意他的要求，就会用一些有毒有害的东西暗算你？”
贾德缓缓点头，“我也是这么想的，此人明显对黑油十分感兴趣，恐怕他还不知道所有黑油也都被我炼器盟收入囊中了，外界能找到百斤黑油就算高产。”

“你们炼器盟把黑油那种没人要的东西弄走干嘛？”
厉久哼了一声，提到矿产这茬后，他心情不算很好。
“自然是有上面的命令，我们历代盟主都要探索黑油并转移。”
贾德取出一枚留影石，照映出黑石城现在的样子。
他指着一个巨大的炼铁厂说道，“林东方已经初步解决了粮食问题，下一步就是各种材料了，你我两家若是再不团结起来，恐怕就要被他逐个击破了。”
“合作…三十六域丹盟盟主里，只有仇胜战力在水平线之上，我等丹修最难提升的就是战力。”
厉久咧嘴一笑，摆明了要先搞一些好处。
“好说好说，我炼器盟最不缺的就是提升你们战力的手段。”
……
就在贾德给厉久挑选宝物提升战力的时候，林东方启动了宝剑号的隐秘行动模式，做到了真正意义上的完全隐匿。
“大哥，你这告诉他说当心霉菌，你要给他下毒啊？”
黑甲圣子想的和厉久差不多。
“下什么毒，我一厨师给人家下毒，往后还怎么干这一行。”
林东方一瞪眼，“一看你就不懂霉菌。”
楚成站在一边不说话，他感觉这次貌似上贼船了！
黑甲圣子嘿嘿一笑，“倒也是，之前你和我们打成那样也没下毒。”
他又好奇问道，“大哥，霉菌到底是啥啊？”
“只要发现黑油，霉菌就会千方百计的将其占为己有，十分疯狂。”
林东方看着下方大星上的石油湖泊，馋的真可谓是抓心挠肝。
“我就这么跟你们说，黑油就是末法时代的灵气，谁有黑油，谁家百姓就能过上好日子。”

“这么离谱！？”
content_en:
"Mold?"
Several people in the living room were stunned.
Black oil can easily catch fire and breed mold?
Moreover, since I started practicing cultivation, mold and hair growth have basically disappeared.
Unless you meet a monk who has cultivated that kind of mushroom, it is really possible to grow mushrooms directly on people.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Lin, for reminding me. I will pay careful attention."
Although Judd didn't know what Lin Dongfang meant by saying this, he still smiled and nodded.
No matter what other people's attitudes were, Judd always kept a smile on his face.
It's quite a bit self-indulgent.
"With that, we'll take our leave."
Lin Dongfang never mentioned the light iron ore from beginning to end.
Chu Cheng and the Black-armored Holy Son didn't ask any further questions, and followed Lin Dongfang aboard the Sword and slowly drove away from the Weapon Refining Alliance star.
On the ground, Judd stared at the Sword, the greed in his eyes undisguised.
"Such a perfect technological treasure...if it can be dismantled to obtain the core technology..."
Judd squinted his eyes and thought for a moment before contacting Li Jiu, the leader of the Dan Alliance.
Not long after, Li Jiu came to Judd's secret room.
“Mold growth?”
Li Jiu was stunned when he heard these four words, and he was also confused.
After thinking for a long time, he suddenly had an idea and said, "Lin Dongfang has no taboos in his actions. Could it be that he is threatening you? If you don't agree to his request, he will use something poisonous and harmful to plot against you?"
Judd nodded slowly, "That's what I thought too. This person is obviously very interested in black oil. I'm afraid he doesn't know that all the black oil has also been collected by our weapon refining alliance. If the outside world can find a hundred kilograms of black oil, it is considered a high yield."
"Why do you, the Weapon Refining Alliance, take away things like black oil that no one wants?"
Li Jiu snorted. He was not in a good mood after mentioning the mining issue.
"Of course there is an order from above. Our past alliance leaders must explore the black oil and transfer it."
Judd took out a picture stone and reflected the current appearance of Black Rock City.
He pointed at a huge ironworks and said, "Lin Dongfang has initially solved the food problem. The next step is all kinds of materials. If you and I don't unite, I'm afraid we will be defeated one by one by him."
"Cooperation... Among the leaders of the Thirty-six Domain Alchemy Alliance, only Qiu Sheng's combat power is above the level. The most difficult thing for me and other alchemy cultivators to improve is their combat power."
Li Jiu grinned and made it clear that he wanted to get some benefits first.
"Easy to say, easy to say, what our Weapon Refining Alliance is most indispensable for is the means to increase your combat power."
…
Just when Judd was selecting treasures for Li Jiu to increase his combat power, Lin Dongfang activated the Sword's covert action mode, achieving complete anonymity in the true sense.
"Brother, if you tell him to be careful about mold, are you going to poison him?"
The black-armored Holy Son thought the same thing as Li Jiu.
"What kind of poison? I'm a chef who poisons people. How can I do this in the future?"
Lin Dongfang glared, "You don't understand mold just by looking at it."
Chu Cheng stood aside and said nothing. He felt like he was on a pirate ship this time!
The black-armored Holy Son chuckled, "That's true, you didn't use poison even when you fought us like that before."
He asked out of curiosity, "Brother, what exactly is mold?"
"As soon as black oil is discovered, mold will do everything possible to take it for itself. It's very crazy."
Lin Dongfang looked at the oil lake on the big star below, and he was so greedy that he was scratching his head.
"Let me tell you this, black oil is the spiritual energy of the Dharma Ending Age. Whoever has black oil can live a good life."
"So outrageous!?"
